Your Guide to the App

Everything you can do in the River Church app — for guests, attendees, and members.

Welcome to the River app

This guide walks through every screen, so you always know what you can do and how to do it. The app grows with you — the further along you are, the more it opens up. Find your spot below.

I'm a Guest

New or visiting — plan a visit, get prayer, and explore.

I'm an Attendee

Coming regularly — check in, join groups, take next steps.

I'm a Member

Covenant member — household, giving, badges, and more.
River · App Guide Guests Attendees Members
For

Guests

Just visiting or brand new? Here's everything the app does for you — from planning your first visit to getting prayer right now.

Home

Home — your welcome screen

Everything a first-time visitor needs, gathered in one friendly place.

What you can do

  • See what's happening this weekend under Featured.
  • Jump straight to Give, Stream, Souls, or the campus Map.
  • Switch between the River Church and RMI looks with the brand toggle.

How to

  1. Open the app — Home is the first tab on the bottom bar.
  2. Tap any card to open it; swipe the Featured banner to see more.
Home · Get involved

Plan your visit & get involved

Simple next steps for anyone exploring River for the first time.

What you can do

  • Plan Your Visit — service times, parking, and kids check-in.
  • Send an I'm New — Connect Card and get a welcome gift.
  • Apply for River University or River School of the Bible, or become a member.

How to

  1. On Home, scroll down to New here? Start here and Get involved.
  2. Tap a card — application links open securely in your browser.
Events

Events — find & register

Browse everything happening at River and save your spot in seconds.

What you can do

  • Search events or filter by Conference, Healing School, or Car Show.
  • Register for any event with a single tap.

How to

  1. Tap Events in the bottom bar.
  2. Use the search box or a category chip, then tap Register.
Requests

Requests & prayer

Reach the church and get prayer the moment you need it.

What you can do

  • Tap the blue bar to call 1-866-85-RIVER and get prayer right now.
  • Submit a prayer or information request and choose who can see it.

How to

  1. Tap the center + (Requests) in the bottom bar.
  2. Tap the call bar to phone us, or fill out the form and submit.
Check-in

Check-in

Check yourself and your family in at any kiosk on campus.

What you can do

  • Show your Guest QR badge to check in.
  • Connect as a new guest and let us know you came.

How to

  1. Tap Check-in in the bottom bar.
  2. Show your code at any check-in kiosk.
Badge

Your guest badge

Your personal check-in code, always in your pocket.

What you can do

  • Enlarge your QR code for easy scanning.
  • Check your family in at kiosks — it links to your church record.

How to

  1. Open your badge from Check-in or More.
  2. Tap the code to make it full-screen at the kiosk.
More

More — settings & help

Settings, support, and your account, tucked on the far-right tab.

What you can do

  • Adjust Settings & Notifications.
  • Get Help & Support or learn About River Church.
  • Change your account type as you grow from guest to member.

How to

  1. Tap More (far right) and choose any item.
For

Attendees

Coming regularly? You unlock check-in badges, groups, the membership path, and more.

Home

Home — your hub

Once you're attending regularly, Home keeps your next steps close.

What you can do

  • Check in fast with Tap & Go.
  • Take a next step: Become a Member, Join a Group, or the Membership Class.
  • Reach Give, Stream, Souls, and Map from the top.

How to

  1. Home is the first tab.
  2. Tap a quick action or one of the Your next step cards.
Badge

Your attendee badge

Your check-in code for you and your whole family.

What you can do

  • Show your QR at any kiosk to check in.
  • See your member-type at a glance.

How to

  1. Open More → Badge.
  2. Tap the code to enlarge it for scanning.
Membership

Membership Class

Your path to becoming a covenant member of River.

What you can do

  • See the benefits of membership.
  • Start the membership course online and Apply Today.

How to

  1. From Home or More, tap Membership Class.
  2. Tap Apply Today to begin the course.
Events

Events — find & register

The full calendar of services, conferences, and gatherings.

What you can do

  • Search and filter by category.
  • Register with one tap.

How to

  1. Tap Events, then Register on anything that interests you.
Requests

Requests & prayer

Prayer and pastoral care are one tap away.

What you can do

  • Call for prayer instantly, or submit a request.
  • Pick who sees it — leaders only or pastoral team.

How to

  1. Tap the center + (Requests).
  2. Call the blue bar, or complete and submit the form.
Groups

Groups & group chat

Find your people and stay connected through the week.

What you can do

  • See the groups you're part of and open the group chat.
  • Browse groups with openings and join one.

How to

  1. Tap Groups.
  2. Open a group to chat, or tap Browse groups to find one.
More

More — account menu

Household, badge, giving, and settings all in one spot.

What you can do

  • View My Household and your Badge.
  • Open Giving, adjust Settings, or get help.

How to

  1. Tap More and choose an item.
For

Members

As a covenant member, the whole app opens up — your household, giving, badge backgrounds, soul reports, and personalized home.

Home

Home — your home base

A personalized welcome with everything you reach for most.

What you can do

  • Quick actions: Give, Stream, Souls, and the Map.
  • Tap & Go check-in for your family.
  • Catch up on Featured and Announcements.

How to

  1. Home is the first tab — tap any card to open it.
Home · Word of the Week

Word of the Week

A weekly confession and verse, straight from Sunday's service.

What you can do

  • Read this week's declaration and scripture.
  • It refreshes every week — and can rotate through several each day.

How to

  1. On Home, scroll past Featured to find the Word of the Week.
Badge

Your member badge

Your check-in code — with a personal touch only members get.

What you can do

  • Show your QR to check in your family.
  • Choose a Badge Background (members only).
  • See your member-since date.

How to

  1. Open More → Badge.
  2. Tap the code to enlarge; pick a background below it.
My Household

My Household

Everyone in your family, kept together and up to date.

What you can do

  • See each member with their role and age.
  • View your address on file.
  • Send a household update to the church office.

How to

  1. Open More → My Household.
  2. Tap Request a Household Update to send changes.
Giving

Giving — your record

Your generosity, clearly laid out and completely private.

What you can do

  • See your year-to-date total and recent gifts.
  • Compare this year to last year.
  • Download your giving statement.

How to

  1. Open More → Giving.
  2. Tap Compare YTD to last year to see the change.
  3. Recent gifts can take up to 45 days to appear.
Giving · Compare

Compare your giving

A simple year-over-year view of your faithfulness.

What you can do

  • See this year versus the same period last year.
  • A clear up-or-down figure and percentage.

How to

  1. On the Giving screen, tap the green Compare YTD to last year pill.
Give

Give securely online

Sow into the ministry in just a few taps.

What you can do

  • Give securely through Pushpay.
  • An animated prompt guides you to the giving button.

How to

  1. Tap Give on Home, then Click here to give securely online.
  2. Giving opens in Pushpay, the church's secure provider.
Souls

Report souls won

Record the harvest and share the testimony of what God did.

What you can do

  • Log the date and place (city, state).
  • Enter the soul count and the testimony.

How to

  1. Tap Souls on Home.
  2. Fill in the fields and submit — it saves to your record.
Events

Events — find & register

Never miss a service, conference, or special gathering.

What you can do

  • Search and filter the full calendar.
  • Register with one tap.

How to

  1. Tap Events, then Register.
Requests

Requests & prayer

Prayer and care, always within reach.

What you can do

  • Call for prayer instantly or submit a request.
  • Choose who can see it.

How to

  1. Tap the center + (Requests).
Groups

Groups & group chat

Do life together — all week, not just on Sunday.

What you can do

  • Open your group chat and keep the conversation going.
  • Browse and join other groups.

How to

  1. Tap Groups, open your group, and start chatting.
Settings

Settings & themes

Make the app feel like yours.

What you can do

  • Switch between Auto, Light, Dark, and Liquid Glass looks.
  • Manage push notifications, event reminders, and prayer responses.

How to

  1. Open More → Settings & Notifications.
  2. Tap a theme or flip a notification switch.
More

More — your menu

Every member tool, one tap away.

What you can do

  • Reach Household, Badge, Giving, Serving, and Giving Statements.
  • Open Settings, Help, and About.

How to

  1. Tap More (far right).
